title: Mass Spec Sample Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware, then select and upload your labware files (must have a .json extension).

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Open the Protocol tab in the OT App and upload your protocol file (must have a .py extension).

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate each piece of labware, the tip rack, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.
